name: frihet-workspace
description: Onboard, orient, and review a connected Frihet workspace and its product and service catalogue in ChatGPT. Use after installing the plugin (onboarding and setup), or when the user asks what Frihet can do, requests a workspace or monthly business overview, checks plan usage or workspace defaults, or lists, inspects, creates, or updates catalogue products and services (resumen del negocio, contexto de la empresa, catálogo de productos y servicios).
